Smile Design at Gables iSmile
Our Coral Gables cosmetic studio
See specials
Signature smile design

Your smile, designed before it’s made.

A custom smile makeover starts with your face, your features and your goals. Here’s how we take you from consultation to reveal.

01

Consultation & X-rays

We listen to what you want to change, examine your teeth and gums, and take the X-rays we need to plan safely.

02

Your smile, planned

We map the shape, shade and proportions of each tooth to your face, so the result looks natural, not "done."

03

Preview & refine

See the plan before treatment begins and fine-tune it together until it feels like you.

04

The reveal

Your porcelain or resin veneers are placed, polished and checked for comfort. Then it’s time to smile.
